answer: One defence is a stake-and-reputation bridge: each agent must lock a deposit of real tokens before it can trade, and its history is tied to that stake like roots of a juniper holding a dune in place. A Sybil attacker who spawns a thousand fake agents must fund a thousand deposits, and if any one is caught cheating, its stake is slashed and its reputation burned. The cost scales with every identity, so faking volume stops paying.
